We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate each story for Minimal criterion. Need understand criterion: A user story contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to story sentence.

We have backlog with 53 stories. Need evaluate each story ID. We need decide binary. We should parse each story text. Most are standard "As a X, I want Y, so that Z." That's minimal. Violation if extra info beyond role, means, optional ends. Need inspect all.

Let's list stories and identify any extra clauses, parentheticals, notes, implementation hints.

PP-001: As moderator, I want to create new game by entering name and optional description, so that I can start inviting estimators. Contains role means ends. No extra. No violation.

PP-002: As moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game, so that we can start game. No violation. "where they can access" is part of means? acceptable.

PP-003: As moderator, I want to start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field, so that we can estimate it. Means includes UI detail? Is this implementation detail? Minimal criterion says nothing more than role, means, ends. "single multi-line text field" is a UI implementation/testing hint? Hmm. It is part of means? User story can include "by entering an item in a single multi-line text field" as means, but "single multi-line text field" is arguably UI detail, but Minimal criterion violation only when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information external to story sentence. This is within story sentence and part of means (how to enter item). Need decide if UI detail violates Minimal? QUS Minimal is syntactic: user story contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends. It doesn't prohibit specificity in means. But "single multi-line text field" might be considered implementation/testing hint? It is not external, it's part of means. We should be cautious. The criterion says "contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale." PP-003 has role, means, ends. So no violation. But if detail is implementation hint could violate? Operational decision rule: "Violation when the core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to the story sentence." "single multi-line text field" is within story sentence. Is it an implementation hint? It suggests specific UI component. However many user stories include "by entering..." details. Could be a means. The definition does not prohibit technical details in means? But "nothing more than role, means, ends" allows means. A "single multi-line text field" could be too implementation-specific? Need align with criterion. Let's see examples from QUS: A story followed by mock-up notes and step-by-step validation instructions violates Minimal because those notes are extra to role, means, ends. Not issue. So extra info outside role/means/ends. PP-003 all sentence is role/means/ends. No violation.

PP-004: "As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session, so that I can answer questions about the current story such as "does this include ___"." Ends includes example quote. Is that extra? It is rationale, with example. Still ends/rationale. "such as ..." is part of ends. Minimal? likely no violation. It is a rationale explaining purpose. No external notes. No violation.

PP-005: As moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated, so that team sees that item and can estimate it. fine.

PP-006: "As a moderator, I want to add an item to the list of items to be estimated, so that so that we can be flexible and accommodate situations where we think of a new story while playing." Notice "so that so that" duplicated. Syntactic error but not Minimal? Contains role means ends but duplicated conjunction. Does this violate Minimal? It's extra word? Could be considered not Minimal? Minimal criterion about extra info not grammar. "so that so that" is a typo. It may still contain role means ends. The criterion "contains nothing more than..." maybe duplicated "so that" is extra words, but not information. We shouldn't invent defect. No violation? Hmm. But it is an error. The decision should be on Minimal. It includes role, means, optional ends. Duplicate "so that" is grammatical issue not Minimal. No violation.

PP-007: As moderator, want to edit item in list so that I can make it better reflect team's understanding. fine.

PP-008: As moderator, want to delete item from list so that we can remove it and not estimate it. fine. Maybe "so that we can remove it and not estimate it" redundant but end. no violation.

PP-009: As moderator, want to show all estimates immediately, so that I can decide to show estimates that have been given even though not all estimators have given their estimate. This is somewhat contradictory? "show all estimates immediately" means maybe reveal current estimates, so that I can decide to show... But still role means ends. no extra. no violation.

PP-010: As moderator, want to accept average of all estimates, so that we can move on to next item when we agree. fine.
